data.body: PLANNING_CONSIDERATION (from preplanning Phase E adversarial review): The corpus schema (_schema.yaml) must reserve domain-name namespace for all 8 SC-4 content domains at Foundation time, even if not all are populated yet. Domains to enumerate in schema vocabulary: gov-benefit-flows, accessibility, principles, anti-patterns, patterns, components, gov-copy. This prevents namespace collisions and tag-vocabulary drift as Enhancement stories ship later.
